text:
```yaml
name: Link Check and Directory Overview

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  link-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout Repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Setup lychee
      uses: lycheeverse/lychee-action@v2
      with:
        args: --config .lychee.toml .
        fail: true

  directory-overview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: link-check
    steps:
    - name: Checkout Repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Generate Directory Overview
      run: |
        find . -type f -not -path "./.git/*" -not -path "./.github/*" | \
        sed 's|^\./||' | \
        sort > directory_overview.txt

    - name: Update README with Directory Overview
      run: |
        echo "# Directory Overview" > temp_readme.md
        echo "" >> temp_readme.md
        echo "This repository contains the following files:" >> temp_readme.md
        echo "" >> temp_readme.md
        cat directory_overview.txt | while read line; do
          if [ ! -z "$line" ]; then
            echo "- \`$line\`" >> temp_readme.md
          fi
        done
        echo "" >> temp_readme.md
        echo "## Quick Links" >> temp_readme.md
        echo "" >> temp_readme.md
        echo "[Back to Main README](README.md)" >> temp_readme.md
        cat README.md >> temp_readme.md
        mv temp_readme.md README.md

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: directory-overview
    steps:
    - name: Checkout Repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install pytest

    - name: Run tests
      run: pytest -q

  test-summary:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    if: always()
    steps:
    - name: Test Summary
      uses: test-summary/action@v2
      with:
        paths: "test-results.xml"
```
